notes: Built one RSVP list with a public RSVP form that guests can fill in from a link.
Headcount is asked as adults and kids separately so you can plan food and party favours.
Allergies are stored privately and asked of the parent answering for their child.
Answers are Coming, Maybe or Can't come, with Coming as the default.
There is no party date, venue or gift list because your sentence did not mention them.

notes: I used your existing Grooming Appointments table, which already holds the dog's name, breed, owner phone and next visit date, so nothing is duplicated.
Its current Booked, Completed and Cancelled statuses and the groomer and notes fields stay as they are.
Your team gets a staff form for adding appointments, but there's no public booking page because you didn't ask for one.
I added a calendar of next visit dates so the week ahead is easy to see.
There are no separate Owners or Dogs tables, to keep this to the one list you described.
I added two example appointments with made-up phone numbers that you can delete.
